meta.source: London Datastore: Financial Capability and Child Poverty (Experian Marketing Services)
meta.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v2 (Experian Marketing Services). The GLA cannot warrant the quality or accuracy of the data (London Datastore terms).
meta.method: lds-harvest-auto.mjs run e64on: resources chosen by the written rules; every row of every sheet or CSV read (CSV over 20 MB streamed and not stored; large xlsx streamed with ExcelJS); a row is kept when it is a zone row (harvest-log.json meta.rules.zone_row): zone OA/LSOA/MSOA/ward code, zone postcode or postcode sector, zone UPRN or TOID, or coordinates in the 3D model box. zone_keys gives the key that matched, row by row. header_rows: the rows above the first data row.
selection_notes: hand rule: the London-wide postcode files (2010 and later) and the LSOA summaries, kept as tables; the tab-delimited twins and the 33 per-borough files repeat them (13 MB with the duplicates as points)
